facts.business: Apex Frozen Foods Ltd. is an integrated processor and exporter of value-added shrimp (mainly L. Vannamei), operating across hatchery, processing, and export functions with a focus on ready-to-cook and ready-to-eat products for global markets.
key_risks: Global trade volatility and tariff-related uncertainties
Geopolitical disruptions impacting logistics and supply chains
Concentration risk in export markets (historically U.S.)
Inventory measurement risk due to estimates in cost allocation and net realizable value of finished goods
